dedicated.description: For a new number that isn't on WhatsApp. Connection is instant, and every conversation is handled from your Zid dashboard only.
dedicated.step1: Enter your business details (name, category, country)
dedicated.step2: Click "Add a new number" and enter the country code and phone number
dedicated.step3: Pick a verification method (SMS or call) and enter the code
dedicated.step4: Click "Finish" and wait for the connection to be confirmed
dedicated.title: Connect a new number

existingApp.description: For a number you already use on the WhatsApp Business app. It needs your approval from the app on your phone, and the number then runs on both platforms.
existingApp.step1: Enter the number linked to your WhatsApp Business app
existingApp.step2: Open the app on your phone and approve the connection request using a QR or access code
existingApp.step3: Pick "Share all messages" so your conversations show up in your Zid dashboard
existingApp.step4: Click "Finish" and wait for the connection to be confirmed
existingApp.title: Connect a number already on the WhatsApp Business app

activate.subtitle: Activation connects your store to WhatsApp Business API, which lets you send campaigns and automated messages from inside Zid.
activate.title: Activate your WhatsApp account on Zid

howTo.step1: Business name: matching the name on your Commercial Registration
howTo.step2: Phone number: an active contact number linked to your store
howTo.step4: Address: city, district, street and postal code matching your National Address

notes.tip2: Make sure all details match your official documents (Commercial Registration and National Address)
notes.tip3: Add products, contact info and a privacy policy to your store, so Meta doesn't flag it as suspicious
notes.title: To keep your account safe:

businessInfo.subtitle: Complete details lower the chance of restriction and raise your account credibility. Fill them in before you start.
businessInfo.title: Complete your business details

howTo.step1: Create a new personal account on <facebookLink>facebook.com</facebookLink>
howTo.step2: Or sign in with an existing account (preferred)

notes.tip1: Use your real full personal name, not your business name
notes.tip2: The account must belong to someone with admin authority over the business (the store owner or an official delegate)
notes.tip3: Use an active personal email, not the store email
notes.tip4: Creating the account from the Facebook mobile app is preferred, to reduce the chance of restriction
notes.tip5: Complete the account details (photo, friends, verified phone number) so it looks genuine and not suspicious
notes.tip6: It must be a personal account, not a business page
notes.title: Important tips:

facebook.subtitle: Your personal Facebook account is the key to opening a Meta business account. Skip this step if you already have one.
facebook.title: Create a personal Facebook account

howTo.step1: Go to <metaLink>business.facebook.com</metaLink> and log in with your personal Facebook account
howTo.step2: Enter your business name, your name and your email
howTo.step3: Click "Submit" and verify your account using the code sent to your email

notes.tip1: After creating your personal account, wait a day or two before creating the business account. Creating both back to back can get the account restricted or blocked.
notes.tip2: Business name must match your website and social media pages.
notes.tip3: Use a work email if possible (e.g., info@yourstore.com), not a personal email.
notes.tip4: Don't use ALL CAPS in your display name.
notes.tip5: Avoid symbols and emojis in your business name.
notes.title: Important notes:

metaBusiness.subtitle: A business account is the central hub for your business assets including WhatsApp. Skip this step if you already have one.

0.description: An unexpected error occurred while sending the message. Please try again or contact support if the issue persists.

1.description: The request failed due to an invalid format or server issue. Please verify your request format and try again. If the problem persists, check WhatsApp Business Platform status.

100.description: Your request contains unsupported or misspelled parameters. Contact support if the issue persists.

130472.description: This message was not sent because the recipient is part of a WhatsApp marketing experiment. This is a temporary restriction by Meta.
130472.title: User in Experiment Group

131000.description: The message failed to send due to an unknown error. Please try again. If the error persists, contact support with the error description.
131000.title: Message Sending Failed

131005.description: Your app does not have the required permissions. Please verify your access token has the necessary permissions in the Meta Business Suite.
131005.title: Access Denied

131008.description: Your request is missing a required parameter. Please review the API documentation and include all mandatory fields.
131008.title: Required Parameter Missing

131009.description: One or more parameter values are invalid. Please check your phone number format and ensure all values meet the API requirements.
131009.title: Invalid Parameter Value

131016.description: A WhatsApp service is temporarily unavailable. Please wait a few minutes and try again. Check WhatsApp Business Platform status for updates.
131016.title: Service Temporarily Unavailable

131021.description: The sender and recipient phone numbers are the same. Please send messages to a different phone number than your business number.
131021.title: Cannot Message Yourself

131026.description: The message could not be delivered. Possible reasons: the recipient is not on WhatsApp, has not accepted the latest Terms of Service, has blocked your number, or is using an outdated WhatsApp version. Ask the recipient to update their app and accept the latest terms.
131026.title: Message Undeliverable

131037.description: Your business phone number does not have an approved display name. Please update your display name in WhatsApp Business Manager and wait for approval before sending messages.
131037.title: Display Name Not Approved

131042.description: There is a billing problem with your WhatsApp Business Account. Please check: payment method is attached, no outstanding dues, credit limit not exceeded, timezone and currency are set, and tax information is provided in Meta Business Manager.
131042.title: Payment Issue

131045.description: The phone number is not properly registered with WhatsApp Business API. Please complete the phone number registration process before sending messages.
131045.title: Phone Registration Error

131047.description: More than 24 hours have passed since the recipient last replied. You can only send free-form messages within 24 hours of the last customer message. Please use an approved message template to re-initiate the conversation.
131047.title: Conversation Window Closed

131049.description: WhatsApp has limited delivery to maintain a healthy ecosystem. The recipient has received too many marketing messages recently. Wait at least 24 hours before retrying. Consider using utility or service templates instead.
131049.title: Delivery Limited by Meta

131050.description: This recipient has opted out of receiving marketing messages from your business on WhatsApp. Do not retry sending marketing messages to this user. Subscribe to the user_preferences webhook to track opt-in/opt-out status.
131050.title: Marketing Messages Blocked

131051.description: The message type you are trying to send is not supported by WhatsApp Business API. Please check the documentation for supported message types.
131051.title: Unsupported Message Type

131052.description: WhatsApp was unable to download the media file sent by the user. The file may be corrupted or inaccessible. Ask the user to resend the media or use an alternative method.
131052.title: Media Download Failed

131053.description: The media file could not be uploaded. Please verify the file format is supported, the file size is within limits, and the file is not corrupted. Check supported media types in the documentation.
131053.title: Media Upload Failed

131057.description: Your WhatsApp Business Account is currently under maintenance, possibly due to a throughput upgrade. Please wait and try again later.
131057.title: Account Under Maintenance

132000.description: The number of parameters provided does not match the template definition. Please verify you are sending the exact number of variables required by the template.
132000.title: Template Parameter Mismatch

132001.description: The template does not exist, is not approved, or the language code is incorrect. Please verify the template name, ensure it is approved in WhatsApp Manager, and check the language locale is correct.
132001.title: Template Not Found

132005.description: The template text exceeds the character limit after variable substitution. Please use shorter values for your template variables or create a new template with shorter text.
132005.title: Template Text Too Long

132007.description: The template content violates WhatsApp policies. Please review WhatsApp template guidelines and modify your template content to comply with their policies.
132007.title: Template Policy Violation

132012.description: The variable parameter values are not in the correct format. Please ensure your parameter values match the format specified in the template (e.g., date format, currency format).
132012.title: Parameter Format Invalid

132015.description: This template has been paused due to low quality rating. Users may have reported it as spam or it has low engagement. Please edit the template to improve quality and resubmit for approval.
132015.title: Template Paused

132016.description: This template has been permanently disabled due to repeated quality issues. It cannot be restored. Please create a new template with improved content that follows WhatsApp guidelines.
132016.title: Template Permanently Disabled

132068.description: The WhatsApp Flow is in a blocked state due to configuration issues. Please review the flow setup, fix any missing inputs or logical errors, and republish the flow.
132068.title: Flow Blocked

132069.description: This flow has been throttled because 10 messages using it were already sent in the last hour. The flow may have endpoint issues. Please fix the flow configuration and wait before retrying.
132069.title: Flow Throttled

133000.description: A previous phone number deregistration attempt failed. Please complete the deregistration process before attempting to register the number again.
133000.title: Incomplete Deregistration

133004.description: WhatsApp servers are temporarily unavailable. Please check the WhatsApp Business Platform status page and try again later.
133004.title: Server Temporarily Unavailable

133005.description: The two-step verification PIN provided is incorrect. Please verify the PIN and try again. If you forgot the PIN, disable and re-enable two-step verification.

133006.description: The phone number needs to be verified before it can be registered. Please complete the phone verification process first.
133006.title: Phone Verification Required

133008.description: Too many incorrect PIN attempts have been made. Your account is temporarily locked. Please wait for the specified time before trying again.
133008.title: Too Many PIN Attempts

133009.description: The two-step verification PIN was entered too quickly. Please wait a moment before trying again.
133009.title: PIN Entered Too Quickly

133010.description: This phone number is not registered on WhatsApp Business Platform. Please complete the registration process before sending messages.
133010.title: Phone Number Not Registered

133015.description: This phone number was recently deleted and the deletion process is not yet complete. Please wait at least 5 minutes before attempting to register it again.
133015.title: Recently Deleted Number

134011.description: WhatsApp Payments terms of service have not been accepted for this account. Please accept the terms of service in WhatsApp Business Manager to continue.
134011.title: Payment Terms Not Accepted

135000.description: The message failed due to an unknown error with your request parameters. Please verify your request syntax against the API documentation and try again.
135000.title: Request Error
